name: light-cmd-palette
description: A lightweight and customizable command palette using only vanilla JS and CSS.

scripts.build:userscripts: esbuild src/commandPalette.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=LightCmdPalette --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/commandPalette.iife.js && mkdir -p dist && cp src/commandPalette.css dist/commandPalette.css
